historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case terminal growth (CNY nominal); the historical CAGRs are not a forward proxy for a developer whose booked revenue lags a contracted-sales series that fell 10.5% in FY2025
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (5.9% / 7.3%) diverges by more than 30% from EPS CAGR (-3.3% / -3.2%) and from revenue CAGR (10.8% / 9.4%): retained earnings keep compounding book while per-share earnings fall, i.e. ROE has slid from 15%+ (FY2019) to 9.0% (FY2025). Revenue growth to FY2025 is the delivery of 2021-23 pre-sales and reverses from FY2026 (H1 FY2026 revenue -28.5%).
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are computed on the owner-FCF series, which equals reported FCF here (SBC zero, interest income not deducted under the net-debt rule). The 3-year FCF CAGR is undefined because FY2022 owner FCF was -22,621m; the 5-year figure (5,365m -> 32,005m) is a land-cycle artefact, not growth. Equity CAGR is on equity attributable to owners (FY2020 203,458 -> FY2025 289,484).

scenario_narratives.base: The residential market keeps shrinking into 2027 but CR Land's booked development revenue settles near RMB160bn (from 238bn) at an 8-10% cash EBIT margin, as 2021-23 land clears at 10% gross margins and the core-city land bought since 2024 delivers at better prices. The malls do the work: rental revenue compounds ~10%/yr to 2030 as the network grows from 98 to ~127 and retail sales keep outrunning national consumption, lifting mall rental from 51% to 60% of group EBIT and the consolidated EBITDA margin from 16.7% to 22.6% purely by mix. Asset-light grows mid-single digits. Attributable owner FCF runs ~RMB17-22bn/yr against RMB174bn of net debt that is refinanced at ~2.7% on the strength of the CRH parent and the A-/BBB+/Baa1 ratings. The axes that decide the value are the development cash margin, the pace of mall openings and rent reversions, and whether the tax-plus-NCI leakage falls as development shrinks.
scenario_narratives.bull: The market bottoms in 2027 and CR Land takes share from retreating private developers, holding contracted sales at 240-260bn and consolidated deliveries at 180-195bn with cash margins recovering to 13% on 'good house' pricing and cheaper land. The mall pipeline is delivered early with positive reversions (rental +15%/yr to 2028), the REIT/Pre-REIT flywheel recycles mature malls at NAV, and 1209.HK compounds third-party contracts. Group EBITDA margin reaches 25%, attributable FCF ~RMB30bn by FY2030, and a terminal mix with more than half of EBIT from rental earns a 20x FCF exit. This needs sales stabilisation, margin recovery and mall growth to all land together.
scenario_narratives.bear: No bottom: national new-home sales fall 7-8%/yr through 2027 and CR Land's consolidated deliveries halve to ~RMB105bn with cash margins of 5-7% after further impairments on 2021-23 land; Vanke/New World-style contagion keeps buyer confidence and land values falling. Consumer softness slows mall reversions to low single digits and the pipeline is cut; 1209.HK stalls. Leakage stays at 48% because project-company losses give no group tax relief. The CRH-linked loan covenants and 40% gearing are not a solvency event in this case (funding cost stays ~3%) but the equity carries RMB174bn of debt against a shrinking FCF of ~RMB13-15bn, and the exit multiple is a developer's 14x, not a landlord's.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A consolidated owner-FCF DCF on attributable cash earnings, with the three segments projected separately and blended. The investment-property portfolio (RMB300bn at fair value) is valued through its rental flows, not added at appraisal value, and the development business is valued on the cash margin it will actually book, not on 'core' profit that adds back impairments. Combined tax-plus-NCI leakage, leases as debt, a CNY-built 7% WACC, and a terminal cap set for a mixed landlord/developer. The result is deliberately below both attributable book (CNY41/share) and a cap-rate NAV, because the equity sits behind RMB174bn of net debt and the development business earns less than its cost of capital at current margins; what the market pays above the DCF value is a bet on cheap SOE debt being a permanent subsidy and on the malls being worth appraisal value to a buyer.
key_risks_to_valuation: Development cash margin: each 1pp on ~RMB160bn of development revenue is ~RMB1.6bn of EBIT (~RMB0.8bn attributable), ~CNY1.5/share of value at the terminal multiple
Mall rental growth and the 127-mall target: the rental segment is 60% of terminal EBIT; a 2pp lower rental CAGR removes roughly a tenth of the base value
Tax-plus-NCI leakage: modelled falling from 52% to 45.5%; if LAT on development and project-partner NCI do not fall with the mix shift, attributable NOPAT is ~5% lower every year

Net debt pairing: attributable flows against 100% of consolidated debt is conservative by the NCI share of project-company debt; the excluded RMB24.6bn of net NCI/related-party receivables (~HK$4/share) is the offset held out
Terminal multiple: 18x vs Gordon 20.4x; a landlord-style 22x adds ~CNY4/share, a developer-style 14x removes ~CNY5/share
Currency: value is built in CNY and converted at HKDCNY 0.8513; a 5% CNY depreciation against the HKD peg lowers every HKD figure by 5%
Fair-value gains (RMB5.9bn FY2025, 5.4bn H1 FY2026) are excluded from EBITDA; the CSV's EBITDA series includes them, so screens that read it will show a higher margin than the model uses

inputs.share_count_basis: 7,130,940,000 ordinary shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (interim report note 23, unchanged since FY2020). No share option or award scheme is in operation: FY2025 basic and diluted EPS are identical (RMB3.56). Count held flat.
inputs.net_debt_note: 30 June 2026 (interim, unaudited). Borrowings RMB271,185m = bank and other borrowings 37,841 + 153,467, super short-term commercial papers 3,002, medium-term notes 11,846 + 52,172, senior notes 12,857; plus lease liabilities 908 + 4,903 = 5,811 (treatment A, leases as debt). Cash RMB97,377m plus time deposits 1,657 + 3,542 = 102,577. Restricted bank deposits (1,537) excluded. Company-defined net gearing at FY2025 was 39.2%.
inputs.last_fcf_note: FY2025 reported FCF = OCF 38,793 - capex 6,788 = 32,005.5 (RMB m). This is a HARVEST figure, not the base: contract liabilities fell from 267.6bn (FY2023) to 143.6bn (FY2025) as pre-sold units were delivered while new land spend was cut, and FY2021-22 FCF was -22.6bn each year when land spend ran ahead of deliveries. Year-1 FCF is built from components (section 2 of owner-fcf.md); the component build for FY2026 lands near RMB17bn, which is the attributable cash-earnings run-rate rather than the inventory-release figure.
inputs.sbc_source: SBC-zero: no share-based payment expense in the FY2018-FY2025 cash-flow statements and no share option scheme in issue (basic EPS = diluted EPS every year). SBC rows kept explicit at 0%; house and street bases coincide, band_position is null by construction.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 interest income RMB1,977m is NOT deducted from last_fcf under the method's net-cash rule (the group carries RMB174bn of net debt), but it IS excluded from the operating EBIT used to build the margin path (FY2025 operating EBIT = segment results 47,954 + other income 3,387 - unallocated 778 - interest income 1,977 = 48,586) so that gross cash netted against gross debt is not also earning inside the flows.
inputs.buyback_note: No repurchases in any year FY2018-H1 FY2026. The flat count is a modelling convention the company has not had to fund; with zero SBC there is nothing to offset.
inputs.dps_note: FY2025 interim RMB0.200 + final RMB0.966 = RMB1.166/share, a 37% payout of core net profit. H1 FY2026 interim RMB0.200 flat (equivalent to HK$0.231, declared 28 Aug 2026).
inputs.fx_note: Statements and all flows in RMB (CNY); shares quoted in HKD on HKEX. HKDCNY=X 0.8513 (Yahoo, 2026-10-12), so model->quote CNY->HKD = 1/0.8513 = 1.1747. Cross-rate check: USDCNY 6.683 / USDHKD 7.8469 = 0.8517. Company's own conversion: 2026 interim dividend RMB0.200 = HK$0.231 (28 Aug 2026) => 0.866, a 1.7% CNY appreciation since, consistent with the move in USDCNY. No dual listing; the 1209.HK subsidiary is a separate HKD security, not a parity instrument.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T08:08:06Z regular close (HKEX; Friday close, 2026-10-12 is a Monday before the Hong Kong open at fetch time)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows. Risk-free: 10-year China Government Bond ~1.8%. Cost of equity = 1.8% + beta 1.15 x China ERP 7.0% (mature-market 5.5% plus country/governance premium) = 9.9%. Pre-tax cost of debt 2.72% (FY2025 weighted average funding cost, record low; S&P BBB+/Moody's Baa1/Fitch A-), after 25% CIT = 2.0%. Market-value weights ~60% equity (HK$217bn = RMB185bn) / 40% net debt (RMB174bn) => 6.7%, rounded up to 7.0% for the measurement uncertainty in a China ERP. The same 7.0% is used in all three scenarios; sector, policy and governance risk are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not in the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: A: leases as debt. Lease liabilities RMB5,811m (30 Jun 2026) are inside total_debt; lease principal (financing) and lease interest (RMB134m H1) are NOT deducted from the flows; EBITDA is post-IFRS-16. Right-of-use assets 4,748m are leased-in sites; their renewal is treated as part of the capex line.
inputs.nci_treatment: Attributable-only flows (adaptation c, first option). Non-controlling interests are RMB128,222m of equity (30% of total) and took 22.6% of FY2025 profit (7,402 of 32,819) and 25.7% of H1 FY2026 profit. The NCI share is folded into cash_tax_rate_path together with income tax, so the driver is a combined LEAKAGE rate: 1 - (1 - tax)(1 - NCI). FY2025 actual: 1 - (1 - 0.385)(1 - 0.226) = 52.4%. Calibration: FY2025 operating EBIT 48,586 x (1 - 0.524) = 23,127 vs core net profit attributable 22,480 + after-tax net interest ~650 = ~23,130. Ties. NCI is therefore NOT deducted in the bridge. Segment leakage differs (FY2025 development 63% = LAT + CIT + project-partner NCI; investment property 38%; asset-light 36%, the latter mostly the 29.9% 1209.HK minority), which is why the blended path declines as development shrinks in the mix.
inputs.nci_debt_mismatch_note: Attributable flows are paired with 100% of consolidated net debt, which over-charges shareholders for the share of project-company debt that economically belongs to NCI partners. Offsetting that, the model excludes net amounts due from NCI of RMB30.4bn (due from 2,129 + 41,255 less due to 13,021 + 501) and net amounts due to related parties of RMB5.8bn - project-funding balances that unwind with the development inventory. The excluded net asset is ~RMB24.6bn, ~CNY3.4 (HK$4.0) per share, held out as the conservative side of the mismatch.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF on the component engine route, with the section-7 adaptations. ROUTING: the business straddles three rows of the dcf-methods table - an inventory-heavy developer (84.6% of FY2025 revenue, 48% of core profit), an IAS-40 fair-value mall/office landlord (9.1% of revenue, 44% of core profit; investment properties RMB300bn at fair value) and an operating fee business (6.3%, 8%; includes 70.1%-owned 1209.HK). It is NOT a REIT (no distributable-profit regime; the malls are self-developed and internally managed, and the group is 40% net-geared against them) and NOT a pure subdivider, so a consolidated cash-flow build is used, with the three segments projected separately and blended into the revenue growth and EBITDA margin paths (segment assumptions in scenario_narratives and assumptions.*.segment_build). Investment properties are NOT added to the bridge because their rental income is in the flows (matching-asset rule); JV/associate investments (RMB91.5bn) likewise stay out because their profit share is inside segment results. First valuation of this ticker; no memory entry. EBITDA BASIS: operating EBITDA excludes fair-value gains on investment properties (FY2025 5,887m), FVPL gains and interest income; FY2025 = 48,586 EBIT + 1,531 D&A = 50,117 = 17.8% of revenue, against the CSV's 57,967 which includes the fair-value gain and interest income. Inventory impairments (which the company adds back in 'core' profit) are NOT added back - the cash margin on delivery is what is modelled, so year-1 attributable NOPAT (~RMB17-18bn) sits below CICC's RMB21.8bn FY2026 core-profit estimate by roughly the impairment add-back. CROSS-CHECKS at the current price: P/B 0.63x on attributable book RMB292bn (BVPS CNY41.0 = HK$48.1); P/E 8.2x on FY2025 core; dividend yield 4.5% on FY2025 DPS; market EV ~RMB359bn against FY2026 base attributable owner FCF ~RMB17bn = 4.7% unlevered yield. PRICE is a Friday regular close, not after-hours; not volatile.

bear.segment_build_note: Development revenue 170, 145, 128, 118, 112 then -3%, -2%, -1%, 0, 0 (national new-home sales keep falling 7-8%/yr through 2027 and CR Land's consolidated deliveries settle near 105bn, under half of FY2025); margin 6%, 5%, 5%, 5.5%, 6%, 6.5%, 7% then flat (continued inventory impairment and price cuts on 2021-23 land). Investment property +16% FY2026 (openings already committed) then +8, +6, +5, +4, +3, +3, +3, +2.5, +2.5 as consumer softness slows reversions and the mall pipeline is cut; margin 60% -> 58%. Asset-light -2% then +2%/yr; margin 13%. Other +0.3bn. Leakage held at 48%: losses at project companies with NCI do not reduce group tax (no group relief), and 1209.HK's minority keeps its share. Cap 14x on a terminal mix that is ~70% rental only because development has shrunk, with the market unwilling to pay landlord multiples for a 40%-geared SOE developer.
bear.capex_rationale: 3.0% of a shrinking base (~RMB5-6bn/yr): pipeline trimmed to committed projects. Working-capital capture -5%: inventory does not release cleanly when unsold stock is the reason revenue is falling.

base.segment_build_note: Development revenue (RMB bn): 175, 162, 158, 160, 163 then +2%/yr (FY2025 238.2; unbooked 164.6bn at FY2025 year-end of which 123.5bn scheduled for FY2026, H1 FY2026 -39%; consolidated revenue ~75% of ~220bn contracted sales once the market flattens). Development EBIT margin 8%, 8.5%, 9%, 9.5%, 10% then flat (FY2025 12.3% segment margin; H1 FY2026 gross margin 10.0%, segment margin 6.0% after impairments; 2024-26 land in five core cities and the 'good house' premium lift delivered margins from FY2028). Investment-property rental: +17.9% FY2026 (H1 +17%, 6-7 openings incl. Xiamen Mixc II), then +11.7, +10.5, +9.5, +8.6, +6, +5, +4.5, +4, +3.5 (98 malls -> ~127 by 2030, then same-store); segment margin 61% -> 62%. Asset-light: flat FY2026 (H1 -0.1%), then +5%/yr tapering to 3.5%; margin 15% -> 17%. Other income net of unallocated costs +0.6bn/yr. Mall rental share of EBIT rises 51% -> 60%.
base.capex_rationale: ~RMB9-10bn/yr: investment-property additions were 6.3bn in FY2025 and 4.8bn in H1 FY2026 (note 12), PP&E ~1bn, with 30 malls in the pipeline toward the 2030 target; FY2023-24 capex of 15.9-24.0bn was the previous build wave. REIT recycling proceeds (Chengdu Mixc disposal H1 FY2026) are NOT netted.
base.wc_rationale: Development net working capital (properties for sale 401bn + receivables 51bn + prepaid tax 19bn - payables 122bn - contract liabilities 161bn - tax payable 17bn = ~171bn, ~70% of development revenue) releases cash as the business shrinks and absorbs it as it grows. -10% capture on the change in consolidated revenue is a deliberately partial release: FY2024-25 showed that land replenishment in core cities and the lag on LAT/CIT settlements (tax payable ran down from 31.0bn to 17.1bn) absorb most of the gross inventory release.
base.terminal_rationale: Cap 18x terminal FCF binds (Gordon at 7%/2% would be 20.4x). Terminal-year EBIT is ~60% mall rental, which at a 5.0-5.5% cap rate trades at 22-25x after-tax FCF, and ~40% development/fee business at 8-10x; the blend is ~17-19x. A 12-15x 'cyclical' cap would price a mature landlord as a homebuilder.

bull.segment_build_note: Development revenue 180, 175, 180, 188, 195 then +3%/yr (market bottoms in 2027 and share gains from retreating private developers hold contracted sales at 240-260bn); margin 9% -> 13% by FY2030 (core-city land bought at 2024-26 prices, 'good house' pricing premium, impairments cease). Investment property +20%, +15%, +13%, +12%, +10% then tapering to +4% (127-mall target met early, luxury tenancy mix and 20%+ retail-sales growth keep rent reversions positive); margin 62% -> 64%. Asset-light +2% then +8%, +8%, +7%, +7% tapering to +4% (1209.HK third-party wins, REIT/asset-management AUM 524bn compounding); margin 15% -> 19%. Other +1.0bn/yr. Cap 20x reflects a terminal EBIT mix of ~54% mall rental with higher development returns.
bull.capex_rationale: 4.5% of a larger revenue base (~RMB11-14bn/yr) funds the faster mall pipeline.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: the development business that still produces 85% of revenue is in a structural, fifth-year decline with no analyst consensus on a bottom, contracted sales fell 10.5% in FY2025, H1 FY2026 development revenue fell 39%, and the 2026 Vanke/New World stress shows contagion still reaches large, previously stable names. Bull cut to 20% because it requires three independent things - sales stabilisation, development margin recovery and accelerated mall growth - to land together. Base 50%. State-parent funding access (A-/BBB+/Baa1, 2.72% cost of debt) is why the bear is a value case rather than a solvency case, and why it is not weighted higher.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
